method: Read RULES.md and TAXONOMY.md; inspect source, execution paths and cleave facts for all inputs and the four flagged archive members; deobfuscate the fake font without network or payload execution; rescan with local traits and compare against git HEAD in an isolated trait snapshot.

comparison_options.note: Initial exploratory scans accidentally enabled reference following because the optional --follow argument requires =none. Controlled baseline/final scans both use =none and explicit trait roots. No artifact trait loss is attributed to removed dependency metadata.

pg.program: Snowflake-managed PostgreSQL privilege-escalation/RCE proof of concept
pg.verdict_basis: At module load, attempts role self-grants, pg_cron identity substitution, creation of an owner-privileged arbitrary-SQL function, privileged role membership, native file-function rebinding and overwriting archiver configuration with a shell identity probe. The explicit boundary-crossing and configuration-injection sequence tips the verdict. A documented PoC and localhost default leave authorized lab use plausible, but no authorization or laboratory deployment context was supplied.
execution_trace: Read DATABASE_URL, fall back to a localhost PostgreSQL connection as snowflake_admin, and use psycopg autocommit. Each conn.execute block is a separate submission.
Grant cluster-wide read/write roles. Schedule a minutely job, then rewrite cron.job username to postgres and its command to create/grant a SECURITY DEFINER function that executes caller-supplied SQL.

Immediately call that function to grant a privileged role. There is no wait for the cron tick, and the fixed jobid=1 does not use the returned scheduling ID. A fresh run can fail here before the later blocks.

Attempt LANGUAGE internal bindings for pg_read_file and lo_export; request /etc/passwd; build a large object containing an archive_command identity probe, export it over postgresql.auto.conf, reload configuration, and switch WAL.
limitations: Successful exploitation is not established. Target role grants, pg_cron configuration and actual server state are unavailable.

RETURN QUERY EXECUTE of GRANT is not a tuple-returning query. The existing repository PostgreSQL second-review record verifies this failure and the invalid internal symbol spellings on stock PostgreSQL 18.6; managed-target behavior was not tested here.
RCE also depends on the existing archiver configuration. The code does not enable archive_mode.
The final command is an identity probe redirected to /tmp, with no exfiltration endpoint. This is exploit code, not an established malware-family identity.
pg.obfuscation: None; nested SQL dollar quoting delimits function bodies and configuration data.

stage.program: Windows Brotli executable downloader using hidden Windows Script Host launchers
stage.verdict_basis: A standalone loader excludes random staging folders from Defender, downloads and launches multiple executables through hidden VBS, and installs a hidden launcher in Startup. This concealed execution and defense evasion has no demonstrated ordinary product purpose.
execution_trace: At load, overrides global.eval and vm.runInNewContext; wraps require with an empty module denylist, so the wrapper blocks no module.
main checks net session. Without admin access it creates a VBS Shell.Application ShellExecute runas request, starts wscript and exits. This requests consent; it does not bypass UAC.

Only process.execPath is passed to the elevated relaunch. An ordinary node stage.js invocation loses the script argument; a bundled self-contained executable is a plausible intended host, but packaging is missing.

AntiVMControl is the string False. Thus the implemented VM-file, low-resource, debugger/tool-process, registry, parent-process and timing checks and continuous monitoring are skipped on the main path. These remain static capabilities, not observed active evasion.
When execution proceeds, writes a Base64-encoded operator key to cache.json. This is encoding, not encryption or credential theft.

Builds HTTPS requests to root.iloveanimals.shop/download/<name> for save_data, stats_db, game_cache and level_db, saves .exe.br files, pipes them through Brotli into executables, and removes the compressed copies. save_data is restricted to the admin path.
With admin access, creates random AppData/Local folders and invokes Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath before staging.

Writes temporary VBS files that run the native programs with window style 0, optionally pass key/server/directory arguments, and delete themselves. Detached cscript processes hide their windows and ignore streams.
For game_cache, copies a VBS launcher into the user Startup folder. The persistent launcher starts the executable without the initial key argument.
limitations: Downloaded executables were not retrieved or executed; their final behavior and family are unknown.
Payload reachability depends on Windows, privileges, consent, executable packaging and server availability. The elevation request is not a bypass.
stage.obfuscation: No encoded JavaScript stage. Brotli wraps native executable responses; Base64 encodes a local key. Native payload contents are unavailable.

zip.program: Trojanized nest-router 1.0.9 source archive with an IDE-triggered, font-disguised JavaScript loader
zip.verdict_basis: The normal NestJS router module flattens route trees and updates routing metadata. A hidden folder-open eslint-check task instead invokes Node on a padded .woff2 file that discovers remote hosts and executes concealed code. That unrelated, deceptive execution chain tips the verdict despite public-registry provenance.
execution_trace: The library sources implement router metadata and route-path helpers; the build script compiles TypeScript and copies library files into examples.

A JSONC .vscode/tasks.json folderOpen shell task runs node ./public/fonts/fa-solid-500.woff2 on Unix or Windows, hides the task/terminal and suppresses output. settings.json declares task.allowAutomaticTasks=true. This is an autorun attempt; workspace trust and editor/task approval behavior still apply.
The fake font starts with substantial whitespace and executable JavaScript, not WOFF2 magic. It contains a rotated 123-entry hexadecimal string table.

Decode table bytes with XOR 201, subtract lookup base 0x151, and rotate eight entries. Independently verified the actual checksum rotation and decoder in QuickJS with only TextDecoder shimmed, a three-second limit, and no file, module, process or network bindings. No payload entry point was run.

Decoded imports are node:http, node:https, node:zlib, node:url and node:child_process. The loader queries Ethereum JSON-RPC endpoints, optionally ETH_RPC_URL, for blocks and transaction nonces associated with a fixed sender.
It first probes blocks around current/prior multiples of 1000. It falls back to a nonce-guided search for the last sender transaction, and finally a Blockscout transaction-list query.

Passes the chosen transaction recipient to a hex-byte decoder. Bytes 0..3 and 4..7 become two dotted IPv4 addresses. Those addresses construct runtime HTTP stage/configuration URLs. They are not knowable from this static artifact alone.
Fetches /0x/cls and /0x/ls over HTTP port 443. It XOR-decodes body bytes with a repeating key, or uses Base64 in x-payload-b64 when the body is empty; GET failure falls back to HEAD.

The first stage is passed to eval and also node -e; the second is passed only to node -e. Children use detached:true, ignored stdio, windowsHide:true and unref(). Global values and require/module aliases are injected into the stage prefix.
limitations: Final remotely served stages and resulting native/credential behavior are unknown. No theft or specific malware-family claim is inferred.
IDE automatic execution remains conditional on the actual editor version, trust/approval configuration and Node availability.
Fact flow graphs report limits for the obfuscated loader; manual decoding and control-flow review establish the relationships beyond those projections.
zip.obfuscation: Whitespace padding, random identifiers, opaque arithmetic, hex/XOR string table with checksum rotation, computed properties and repeating-key XOR payload reconstruction.

rule_changes.reason: ShellExecute runas asks for administrator consent. Hostile UAC-bypass classification and T1548.002 were unsupported; keep notable elevation and WScript behavior.

A detached process option is a neutral process capability, not a payload chain. Require detached:true rather than mere presence of the option name. The HTTP-response command-execution consumer was updated and its existing hostile fixture still matches.
A suffix reference alone proves no download. Add a word boundary so .exe.browser does not match .exe.br.

The matcher establishes a compressed-executable suffix near a decompressor, not a fetched-input or output-file relationship. Preserve the original proximity and notable observation with an honest description.

Brotli plus hidden installer execution can be legitimate. Require an executed Defender-exclusion command before asserting hostile staging. Preserve the confirmed sample and move its result to the payload-execution home. The larger bounded window includes that independent admission evidence.

The original regex only found image/protocol-handler names in the stage process allowlist. Require call/argument forms selecting an OS handler. Update the default-handler exception and existing browser-launch fixture without adding a sample-name exclusion.

A quoted rundll32.exe allowlist entry is not command text. Require an argument following the command. The actual rundll32 command control still matches; the stage retains its accurate canonical executable-name reference.

CPU capacity, memory and uptime comparisons alone are neutral. Preserve the three raw matchers, scopes and notable severities in capability homes, remove unsupported evasion mappings, and require explicit analysis wording in the suspicious resource-profile composite.

These unchanged symbol-name matchers describe source naming rather than path/extension access. This corrects placement and keeps the full extension leaf within its existing reviewed capacity; no matcher or severity was erased to make room.

A tree query binds the constructed Startup directory to the target script path and that same target to copyFileSync. The hostile composite additionally requires Defender exclusion and hidden VBS launch. Unrelated-copy and Cache-directory controls do not establish persistence.

consumer_review.decisions: Update the direct command-response consumer and the default-handler exception. Retain the relocated admitted Brotli objective in applicable payload selectors and quarantine/npm duplicate-suppression consumers. Do not copy neutral suffix, runas or resource observations into objective selectors or suppressors. The long-string metric may remain visible independently; no new suppression was added merely to conceal an accurate metric. PE-only hosts/CrystalX consumers cannot receive these JavaScript observations. Other moved symbol observations have no direct consumers.

checks.focused_cases: 19 passed, including existing command-response malware, concealed VBS controls and a benign browser-opener archive. python3 testdata/triage/acquit-registry-review-2026-10-21/check.py
checks.artifact_integrity: SHA-256 values match all three supplied hashes. Only trait/fixture files and judgement markers were written; sample contents were unchanged.
checks.full_rescans: Controlled atomscan baseline/final comparison includes every analyzed archive member. PostgreSQL and all archive findings are identical. Stage changes are the documented relocations/corrections plus Startup coverage.
checks.final_required_command: make validate (run as the final action after this record and markers are written)

material_detection_losses: No supported attack behavior lost. The hostile normal-consent claim became a notable elevation observation. Two nonexistent process-launch claims from an allowlist disappeared; image references remain. Generic installer and capacity-sizing controls no longer receive unsupported attack interpretations. Existing actual command-response attack coverage is retained.
classifier_disagreements: None on the three supplied artifacts: all remain flagged with displayed probabilities 0.97, 0.99 and 0.99. Individual stage model probabilities changed slightly; there is no evidence of a newly exposed classifier miss.
coverage_limits: The raw obfuscated fake-font scan detects its hostile remote-execution chain and obfuscation but does not separately label the decoded Ethereum rendezvous mechanism. No duplicate or sample-specific signature was added to compensate. The scanner also reports limited source-flow projections and a shipping v18-model/v19-extractor compatibility warning.
